! snmp: the SNMP block of scope 'lab' (its communities, access lists, trap hosts and 'enable traps' lines)
ip access-list standard POLLERS
 permit host 192.0.2.60
 permit 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255
snmp-server community poller-ro RO POLLERS
snmp-server host 192.0.2.61 version 2c poller-traps
snmp-server enable traps snmp linkdown linkup
! aaa: the login method of the console and vty lines
line con 0
